افتلين (form VIII)
# اِفْتَلَيْنَ (iftalayna) /if.ta.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# اُفْتُلِينَ (uftulīna) /uf.tu.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
